requirement_results.statement: Maintain an atomic, source-linked Stage-2 requirement catalogue.

Represent rounding-policy identity without selecting business-specific rounding.
Define a versioned event successor/codec while preserving M1 EventEnvelope.
Define a narrow versioned command envelope without execution authority.
Keep event/command, correlation/causation and idempotency identities distinct.
Define pure generic contract-level state transitions only.
Define persistence ports and typed outcomes without a production adapter.
Distinguish success, failure and concurrency conflict as typed outcomes.
Define contract-level inbox/outbox transactional and idempotency semantics.
Distinguish exact duplicates from conflicting idempotency-key reuse.
Define optimistic-concurrency version tokens and stale-write outcomes.
Integrate versioned contracts, compatibility tests and state-machine properties for GATE-S02-01.
Integrate evidence introduced and owned by each earlier slice.
